messages:
nina: prepping a midnight deploy for llm-routing v3 (eu-west). Proposal: phased FF enable with a conservative soak, session-affinity pin for live users, and automated safety-throttle that steps traffic back on metric regressions. Posting runbook for review.

deploybot: Scheduled window: 2026-03-25 00:30 UTC. Plan: enable feature-flag `route.llm.v3` at 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~40m with 10m soak at each step. Safety policy: metric-triggered rollback to prior step + hold. Runbook snippet: `/deploybot ff ramp --name=route.llm.v3 --steps=2,10,50,100 --soak=10m --pin=active_sessions --safety=metric-backoff`

josh: thumbs up. Can we make the first step 1% instead of 2%? low-volume services get noisy. Also request that deploybot publish per-cohort counts during each step.

sre_oncall: I'll monitor latency/error and have a dashboard ready. Trigger rules: if ERR_RATE increase > 2% absolute OR p95 > 300ms for 3m -> backoff. Also set an operational circuit to cut to v2 at REQ_ERRORS > 5x baseline for any 2m window.

infra: We'll pin previous stable version (v2) for cohorts X,Y for 1h to ensure a simple rollback path. Pin command: `/infra ff pin --name=route.llm.v3 --cohorts=X,Y --version=v2 --duration=1h` Auto-unpin only after stable 1h at 100% or manual approval.

nina: release notes snippet: "llm-routing v3 gradual rollout with session-affinity pin and metric-backoff safety policy. Canary thresholds and rollback steps included." Adding the ramp commands to the release doc.

josh: quick ops checklist to include in thread: 1) enable verbose tracing for routing decisions, 2) ensure deploybot EMERG key is oncall's pager, 3) confirm capacity headroom (GPUs at <65%).

sre_oncall: I'll be onwatch for first 45m and will escalate to infra if circuit trips. Posting dashboard link when available.

nina: rollback procedure: immediate disable via `/deploybot ff set route.llm.v3 0`, then unpin cohorts and validate v2 traffic for 15m before clearing. Keep this thread as the single-source-of-truth during the window. :white_check_mark:
